"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"| `dsh-codebase-memory-watcher` | Same package, second bundle id; spins up a chokidar watcher per pr"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"oject, debounces file edits, and re-runs `index_repository` via the global `codebase-memory-mcp` CLI"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ct, debounces file edits, and re-runs `index_repository` via the global `codebase-memory-mcp` CLI. |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The watcher never owns the MCP client connection — it shells out to `codebase-memory-mcp cli index_r"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"epository '{"repo_path":"..."}'` for each rebuild, which is acceptable because the upstream indexer "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"is fast enough on small projects (< 30 s for `dsh-github`)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Watcher routes (auto-registered when `webServer` is available)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Method + path | Body / query | Effect |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `GET /api/dsh-codebase-memory/watcher/list` | – | List every persisted watcher with `status`, `las"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"tRun`, `lastDurationMs`, `lastError`, … |
| `GET /api/dsh-codebase-memory/watcher/status?id=<id>` | "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"– | Same payload for a single watcher. |
| `POST /api/dsh-codebase-memory/watcher/start` | `{ repoPa"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"th, debounceMs?, mode?, ignored?, watchedExtensions? }` | Start a watcher (persists state, returns t"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"he new `id`). |
| `POST /api/dsh-codebase-memory/watcher/stop` | `{ id }` or `?id=` | Stop + mark st"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"opped (state kept). |
| `POST /api/dsh-codebase-memory/watcher/rebuild` | `{ id }` | Trigger an imme"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"diate rebuild regardless of pending edits. |
| `POST /api/dsh-codebase-memory/watcher/restart` | – |"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" Restart every non-stopped watcher from persisted state. |
| `POST /api/dsh-codebase-memory/watcher/"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"auto-attach` | – | Call `list_projects` on the MCP server and start a watcher for each project not a"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"lready covered. |
| `GET /api/dsh-codebase-memory/watcher/cli-info` | – | Report the resolved `codeb"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ase-memory-mcp.exe` path. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Defaults (configurable in `cordis.patch.yml`)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- `debounceMs`: `5000` (5 s quiet period before rebuild)
